description: This header file defines the declaration of the LocalStore class within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace. The class implements the ILocalStore interface and provides methods to manage a local data store backed by an SQLite database, including opening the database, creating tables, setting limits, retrieving entries, removing entries, and adding entries.

classes.name: LocalStore
classes.description: Implements a local data storage backed by SQLite database, providing methods to manage database tables and entries.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens a database connection at the specified path.

methods.name: CreateTable
methods.description: Creates a new table in the database.

methods.name: SetLimit
methods.description: Sets a limit on the number of entries for a specific table.

methods.name: GetEntriesCount
methods.description: Retrieves the count of entries within a specified range from a table.

methods.name: GetEntries
methods.description: Retrieves a list of entries from a table starting from a certain index.

methods.name: RemoveEntries
methods.description: Removes entries from a table within a specified range.

methods.name: AddEntry
methods.description: Adds a new entry to a table.

methods.name: buildGetEventsQuery
methods.description: Builds an SQL query string to retrieve events from a table within a range.
